page.overview:
Who is Crosswise?

Crosswise is a monster hunter, and shares the following attributes of all the better practitioners of his craft:

Eons ago, reportedly Crosswise captured and imprisoned lots of Decepticon "monsters" in a crazy egg-cave-place on Earth.

He was subsequently entombed in ice himself, till some humans freed him.

Crosswise's first thought on being de-iced was frantic concern over his imprisoned "monsters", and so he rushed to the prison site to check on them. It turned out that the hundreds of Decepticons had stayed put quite nicely... until Starscream found the prison by following the oblivious Crosswise, and promptly liberated all the prisoners to serve as his personal army.
